meta.description: Record your screen and camera, share a link instantly.

auth.headline: Say it once, on video.
auth.tagline: Record your screen and camera and share a link the moment you stop. Open source and yours to host.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Record your screen and share the link the moment you stop.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to record and share.

errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or use another email.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete that. Please try again.

dashboard.noWorkspace: You are not part of any workspace yet.
dashboard.libraryEmptyBody: Record your screen and camera. Every video you make will show up here with its link, views and comments.

errors.unreachable: The server is unreachable. Check that the API is running.
errors.unexpected_response: The server sent an unexpected response.
errors.load_failed: We couldn't load your workspaces. Please try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

recorder.title: New recording
recorder.systemAudioHint: Works when you share a browser tab. Desktop audio on Linux and macOS is not available to browsers.
recorder.shareHint: Your browser will ask which screen, window or tab to share.
recorder.limitHint: Recordings can be up to {minutes} minutes long.

session.confirmDiscard: Discard this recording? It can't be recovered.

result.title: Your recording is ready
result.subtitle: It's saved in this browser. Upload and share links come in the next release.
result.shareSubtitle: Anyone with the link can watch it. It was copied to your clipboard.
result.uploadFailed: The video couldn't be fully uploaded, so the link isn't ready. Download it to keep a copy.
result.localOnly: It is saved in this browser only. Download it to keep a copy.

recovery.title: Unfinished recording found
recovery.body: From {date}, about {duration} long. Its last saved part is kept.

errors.permission_denied: Permission was denied. Allow access in your browser's site settings and try again.
errors.device_not_found: We couldn't find that device. Check that it's connected.
errors.device_busy: The device is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
errors.capture_failed: We couldn't start the capture. Please try again.
errors.encoding_failed: Encoding failed and the recording stopped. What was saved can still be downloaded.
errors.storage_failed: The browser ran out of storage space. Free some space and try again.
errors.unsupported_browser: This browser can't record video. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
errors.no_screen_capture: This browser can't capture the screen. You can still record with the camera only.

share.label: Share link
share.liveHint: People with the link can watch while you record.
share.offline: Couldn't reach the server. This recording is saved only in this browser.

upload.failed: {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} couldn't be uploaded

share.liveHint: Recording in progress. The video grows as it is recorded.
share.playerError: This video can't be played right now. Try again in a moment.
share.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, or it isn't shared with you.
